title: A local map from a regular local ring sending a regular system of parameters to a regular sequence is flat
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] ($\varphi(\mathfrak m_R)\subset\mathfrak m_S$). Assume $R$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] of dimension $d$ and $x_1,\dots,x_d\in R$ generate $\mathfrak m_R$ (a regular system of parameters), and that $\varphi(x_1),\dots,\varphi(x_d)$ is a regular sequence in $S$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]: for each $i$, $\varphi(x_i)$ is a nonzerodivisor on $S/(\varphi(x_1),\dots,\varphi(x_{i-1}))S$, and $S/(\varphi(x_1),\dots,\varphi(x_d))S\ne0$. Then $\varphi$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 07DY (lemma-flat-over-regular, line 32694); its proof is a descending induction with the local criterion of flatness (lemma-variant-local-criterion-flatness)

proof.text: Induct on d, generalizing the source and target rings and the local map. For d=0, the length hypothesis makes x empty. Its generated ideal is zero, so generation of the maximal ideal gives m_R=0. Mathlib IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq makes R a field, and RingHom.Flat.of_isField gives flatness (the module-over-field-flat leaf).

For d+1 write x=r::rs. Package length and maximal-ideal generation as a regular system of parameters. Apply IsRegularLocalRing.isRegular_and_quotients_of_generators: the list is regular in R and A=R/(r) is regular local of dimension d, by its c=1 initial-quotient assertion. Thus r is a nonzerodivisor in R. The first element belongs to m_R, and its image belongs to m_S by locality.

Put B=S/(phi(r)). Its defining ideal lies in m_S, hence is proper; B is nonzero, local and Noetherian. Define psi:A->B by Ideal.quotientMap. To check it is local, lift a class in A to t in R: if psi(t) is a unit, the local quotient map S->B reflects units, then phi reflects units, so t and its class in A are units. Surjectivity of R->A identifies the maximal ideal of A with the image of m_R. Mapping the generation equality and killing (r) shows that the images of rs generate this maximal ideal.

The private proved helper regular_quotient_tail applies Mathlib isRegular_cons_iff' and transports the resulting regular tail from QuotSMulTop phi(r) S to B. The linear equivalence comes from phi(r) times the top submodule equalling the principal ideal, and extends scalars along the surjective quotient map. QuotientMap evaluated on representatives identifies the mapped tail with the images under psi of the images of rs in A. The tail has length d. Apply the induction hypothesis to psi to obtain psi.Flat.

Apply the private proved helper flat_of_quotient_nonzerodivisor to r. Give S the R-algebra structure induced by phi, and B the A-algebra structure induced by psi. The equality r times top=(phi(r)).restrictScalars R follows from ideal_span_singleton_smul and Ideal.smul_top_eq_map. Submodule.quotEquivOfEq followed by restrictScalarsEquiv identifies QuotSMulTop r S with B over R; extendScalarsOfSurjective makes it A-linear. Transport psi.Flat along this equivalence. The heads of the source and target regular sequences give the two injectivity hypotheses, and injectivity on R implies membership in nonZeroDivisors R. Apply RingTheory.flat_of_localCriterion_nonzerodivisor with M=S (a finite module over itself), r in m_R and the transported quotient flatness. It yields Module.Flat R S, which is phi.Flat.
